summary: Stage 6E — Guest review tracker — fully tested end-to-end against the public preview. Backend: NEW pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_stage6e_reviews.py = 31/31 PASS (meta shape + auth, CRUD + priority/sentiment/response_status derivation, priority_flag_manual override + revert, sentiment manual override, rating/source validation 400s, all 8 GET filter permutations, analytics shape+math, /reviews/for-guest lowercase+sort, CSV import preview→confirm with priority reconciliation, RBAC: 401 no-auth, meta OK for staff, staff visibility filter, staff POST/PUT/DELETE 403). Regression: 122/122 PASS (test_stage6b_tasks + test_stage6c_schedules + test_stage6d_inventory_and_auth + test_csv_importer). Frontend (Playwright on the public preview URL): admin login → Dashboard reviews-kpi-card renders (avg + response + priority Links); Sidebar nav-reviews visible (admin+manager); /reviews page renders 4 KPIs + analytics-by-property + analytics-by-source panels once data exists + all 7 filter widgets; new-review-button opens review-form-modal → fill guest_name/star-2/Booking.com/chip-cleanliness+communication/review_text → sentiment auto-set to Negative → submit → modal closes + 'Add another' toast fires + review appears in reviews-list with priority-badge-{id}; edit-review-{id} opens pre-filled → toggle response_sent to true → save → 'Review updated' toast + priority badge disappears; delete-review-{id} removes the row. Staff RBAC on frontend: nav-reviews HIDDEN for staff, new-review-button HIDDEN on /reviews for staff, and staff sees ONLY reviews for their assigned_properties (verified by seeding 2 reviews across 2 properties, then confirming the staff sees exactly 1). GuestReviewsPanel: navigating to /guests/{id} shows the guest-reviews-panel below cancellation history. Regression smoke: /, /tasks, /inventory, /reservations, /segments, /import, /properties, /campaigns, /reports all load without console errors (recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings are pre-existing, unchanged from iteration_10-11).

issues: Pre-existing recharts width(-1)/height(-1) container warnings on initial render — documented in iteration_10/11, not regressed.

React warning `\`value\` prop on \`input\` should not be null` fires once when opening the edit modal for a review with a null review_date/guest_email. Non-blocking — the initial spread merges over BLANK so most fields end up string. Minor: normalise `initial.guest_email ?? ""` in the useState initializer (ReviewFormModal.jsx:34-41) to silence the warning.

action_items: (Optional polish) In ReviewFormModal.jsx BLANK spread merger, coerce null string fields to '' to silence the 'value prop should not be null' React warning (edit mode). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: review_service.py is clean and well-factored: SOURCE_PLATFORMS (9), CATEGORY_TAGS (7), SENTIMENTS (3) match spec exactly. compute_priority_flag correctly treats priority_flag_manual=None as 'auto rule' and any bool as override. suggest_sentiment thresholds (>=5 Positive, >=3 Neutral, else Negative) match spec.

PUT /api/reviews/{rid} handler in server.py (lines 2897-2943) does the right thing: it merges patch over existing, THEN runs _apply_review_recompute which only re-derives sentiment when the current merged sentiment is falsy — so manual sentiment persists through a PUT that touches other fields (verified by test_manual_sentiment_persists and test_flip_response_sent_clears_priority_but_keeps_sentiment).
_review_visibility for staff with empty assigned_properties returns `{property_id: '__none__'}` which correctly returns zero rows (rather than leaking everything). Good defensive default.

GET /api/reviews `q` search is applied client-side (in-memory) AFTER the Mongo filter — fine for the current data volume (5000 row cap) but could become a hot-spot at scale. Consider a Mongo text index or regex $or match on the four fields if the collection grows past a few thousand.

CSV import: parse_reviews_csv correctly reuses csv_importer.decode_csv_bytes for encoding fallback and normalises source/categories/sentiment on the way in. sentiment defaults to suggest_sentiment(rating) when the CSV column is empty. Priority flag is recomputed at insert time (via build_review) so a rating=1 unresponded row does get priority=true even if the CSV had no such column.

Frontend Reviews.jsx: onSaved passes wasCreate correctly so the 'Add another' toast action is only shown on create — matches spec. Edit path shows 'Review updated' toast (no 'Add another'). Good UX distinction.
ReviewsKPICard on the dashboard correctly wraps each KPI in <Link to='/reviews'> (and /reviews?priority_only=1 for the priority tile) so the KPIs are all clickable navigations as required.

Frontend Layout.jsx sidebar entry 'nav-reviews' is gated to admin+manager only — confirmed hidden for staff. The route itself is not gated in App.js (staff can direct-navigate to /reviews) — Reviews.jsx correctly hides the new-review-button and the useEffect fetches analytics only when isMgr, so staff see a scoped list with no write actions. This matches the review request note ('route not admin-gated on frontend — verify only their assigned-property reviews load and new-review-button is NOT shown').
GuestReviewsPanel uses /api/reviews/for-guest?email=… which lowercases the query — correctly handles mixed-case emails from the CRM. Verified via test_for_guest_lowercase_and_sort.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all Stage 6E flows (admin create/edit/delete/toast/priority badge/analytics panels/dashboard KPI card; staff nav-hide + new-review-button-hide + visibility filter; guest-reviews-panel) + 9/9 regression pages load without console errors
